documents.value: EPOK申請須先獲母校提名並取得線上密碼，全件以英文完成：Statement of Purpose、Certificate of Health、Letter of Recommendation（前三件用EPOK表格）、護照資料頁、母校正式成績單、照片；非英語母語者另上傳英語能力證明。文件備齊後完成所有線上頁面並上傳，提交成功寄確認email。

calendar.value: FALL2027交換期間2027年10月–2028年2月；暫定抵達2027/9/24，錄取通知預計6月底、CoE預計8月中、宿舍通知8月底。orientation TBA，不能填成確定日。

eligibility.value: EPOK合作校在學全時學生，申請與交換期間須維持母校學籍，完成至少第一年且學業良好；host最低GPA2.0，原文未明列換算尺度，不能當臺大校內門檻。

language.value: EPOK非英語系國家申請者須英語證明，列TOEFL PBT500／iBT61或4.0、IELTS overall5.5、MUET4、GEPT中高級、DAAD各項至少四星。文件項目第7點限非英語母語者，兩種措辭的例外適用須與EPOK確認。這是host要求；臺大一般組校內IELTS6／TOEFL79或4.0等門檻仍獨立適用。
remaining_questions: 國家／母語例外的適用、證明效期、臺大提名語組。

manual_review.scope:
Application Guide 2027–2028，共21頁；明列2027年10月入學流程。課程交換與研究交換身分必須分開。
2027/28筑波官方網頁與指南有截止日衝突，未選定任一日期為已確認；不啟用確定日期提醒。

eligibility.value: 課程交換Tokubetsu Chokogakusei開放學士與研究生，一至兩學期；研究交換Tokubetsu Kenkyugakusei限研究生，一至12個月，研究身分不取得修課學分。
remaining_questions: 臺大協議允許的身分與期間；研究型申請是否須事先取得指導教授同意。JASSO2.30係獎學金成績尺度，不能当作一般交換門檻。

language.value: 日本語・日本文化學類須JLPT N1或N2；Service Engineering碩士須N1，官方JLPT成績證明不可用母校證明代替。英語TOEFL79或Cambridge FCE列為recommended，不能轉寫成全校硬性門檻。
remaining_questions: 所選學程授課語言與可用英語課；新制TOEFL是否採用、證明效期及其他系所要求。

documents.value: 課程申請：近1月照片、近3月受入依頼書（母校校長或院長簽名）、前1年正式成績單、近3月在學證明、護照、特定類型自我申告（適用研究生）。CoE系統另含財力、JLPT、曾在日證明及結核證明（適用者）；學修計畫英語至少400字／日語800字。財力半年JPY720000、一年JPY1440000。
remaining_questions: 提名後最新版表格與CoE規定；確認國籍別結核證明是否適用，不把條件文件要求套用所有臺大學生。

deadlines.value: 2027年10月入學：提名2027/2/1–2/28。線上申請／CoE文件截止，官方主頁列2027/3/5，2027–2028指南PDF第3頁列2027/3/6，狀態conflict，須向筑波及臺大承辦確認；不可視3/6為已確認截止。2027年4月另一輪同樣有主頁2026/10/9與指南10/10差異，非116-1秋季期限。
remaining_questions: 筑波確認2027秋實際截止日期、時區／時分；臺大提名適用輪次。

calendar.value: 2027年10月入學交換起始10/1；指定抵達日預計6月底公告、秋季抵達約9月中。AB與ABC module結束時間不同，申請後不得自行縮短／延長交換期。
remaining_questions: 指定抵達日、課程模組與實際結束／考試日期；不在公告前以預估日訂票。

housing.value: 提供Ichinoya區單人校內宿舍，約開課前2個月詢問房間需求；僅本人入住，交換期結束須退宿。
remaining_questions: 當期宿舍費、押金、申請截止與實際分配／入住通知。

cost.value: 免學費時估計生活及就學支出半年JPY720000／一年JPY1440000；此亦列財力最低證明額。非協議學生另列學費，不可套用臺大免學費交換。
remaining_questions: 確認臺大本期互免學費協議及實際宿舍／雜費；估算與必繳費分開。

courses.value: 課程交換每週至少8節／600分鐘；研究交換每週至少600分鐘研究活動且不取得課程學分。Business Sciences、Law School、MBA in International Business研究生學程不開放；AB module學生不能修C module。
remaining_questions: 所選學程可取得至少8節課與先修是否符合；研究型與課程型身分不可混用。

remaining_questions: 最新CoE及國籍別材料、教育研究意外保險實際保費；核對正式抵達與入境通知。

completion_observations.text_zh: Natural Sciences與Technical Sciences交換初申須上傳英文測驗成績或報名收據，測驗在申請時不得超過2年；舊TOEFL最低83、新制最低4.5且各項4.0、IELTS Academic/online6.5，亦列Cambridge。母校在指定國家、CircleU夥伴或目前就讀全英語學士/碩士可豁免；最後一項須母校確認信。
completion_observations.scope: incoming exchange；僅自然/技術學院初申硬性文件與列明豁免

value.heading: 實用資訊
value.text: FAQ International Students (must read!) Preparatory German course : Before the semester begins, you will have the opportunity to participate in an intensive German course. Language courses are conducted by the TUDIAS language school. You can find information about course offers, dates, times, and fees on the homepage of TUDIAS . VISA application information (Question 8) Cost of Living per Month (in EUR): Approx. 900 EUR Additional fees: Semester fee, approx. 350 EUR per semester. All regularly enrolled students must pay a nominal "student payment" that covers the Studentenwerk, the Studentenschaft, and the so-called "Semester Ticket" (this semester ticket serves as transportation pass for busses, trains, trams, S-Bahn/Metro, and rental bike service in and around the greater Dresden area and as Deutschlandticket, i.e. for all basic public transport in Germany).

value.text: 交換學校一覽表所列之語言能力為該校之最低門檻要求，同學需自行確認語言能力是否符合該校修課要求、查詢是否有 相對應的系所及 足夠的課程可供選讀、能否達到該校之每學期修課學分數要求、以及是否具備相關領域之背景知識，若未達標準，該校有權拒收。 該校僅部分領域碩士班提供英語授課課程，僅具英語能力者請自行確認是否具備相關修課背景並有充足課程可選讀。 Website of incoming exchange student information Course catalogue (Question 3)→ 請同時確認各領域之授課語言 NOT open to exchange students: Faculty of Medicine. Currently, Faculty of Biology and Faculty of Chemistry only offer German courses for exchange students.

value.heading: 實用資訊
value.text: Before the semester starts, a preparatory German Pre-Semester Intensive Course is being offered in September or March. It costs approximately. €295, and students will be awarded 6 ECTS. Most Erasmus students are only eligible to take part if they have proven German proficiency at the A2 level until the application deadline and after passing the evaluation test upon their arrival. Students also have the chance to attend German courses during the semester. Information can be found on the "ZEMS" website . Insurance Information VISA application information FAQs & Timeline Cost of Living Expenses: Housing €350-650 per month/food and drink €150 per month/books and supplies €40 per month/health insurance (if not waived) € 120-130 per month. Students applying for a residence permit have to prove sufficient financial resources of €992 per month – this will give you a rough estimate of what the average student needs. Depending on the individual lifestyle, this can be less or more.

completion_observations.text_zh: FAQ 舊預算約每月 €900，住宿 €350–650、餐食 €150，學期分攤約 €250 含公共運輸；同頁仍引用2023年財力額，費用與簽證財力須另核最新版本。

value.heading: 住宿資訊
value.text: KIT reserves rooms in student residences for students from partner universities. Accommodation is guaranteed if students adhere to the application procedure and deadlines. Details are sent by email after admission to KIT. The furnished single rooms cost between €250 and €350 per month and are rented for fixed lease periods: October to March (winter semester) and/or April to September (summer semester) . Please note that these rental periods are non-negotiable, and no alternative move-in or move-out dates are available. Please note that accommodation prices on the private market are significantly higher than those in student dorms, and there is also a risk of scams . For this reason, we highly recommend applying for a room in a student dorm through us. For students attending the pre-semester German language course (starting mid-September in the winter semester/mid-March in the summer semester), we recommend reserving accommodation in youth hostels, hostels, or Airbnb for the two weeks before the rental period of guaranteed rooms in the student residences. This must be arranged privately, as KIT unfortunately cannot assist with finding housing on the private market.

value.heading: 實用資訊
value.text: For a good start to the semester at KIT, all incoming students are allowed to participate in a three-week German language course (beginners and intermediate A2-B2) before the semester begins. This course is not a substitute for the certificate of the German language level required for the application . The course fee is 75 euros for international students. Students will get 4 ECTS if they attend 80% of the course and pass the exam. During the semester, the Studienkolleg at KIT offers free German language courses for all students enrolled at KIT. Health insurance coverage is mandatory for your entire stay in Germany, with unlimited coverage. You can either obtain private health insurance in your home country before arriving in Karlsruhe or take out a German public health insurance before or after arrival. However, we strongly recommend choosing German public health insurance , as many private policies from non-EU countries may not be accepted. Without valid insurance, enrolment at the university is not possible. Students from partner universities pay a charge for the Studierendenwerk of about 92 € per semester. This includes reduced student prices at the university restaurant, transportation reductions, and accident insurance. Cost of Living

value.heading: 實用資訊
value.text: For a good start to the semester at KIT, all incoming students are allowed to participate in a three-week German language course (beginners and intermediate A2-B2) before the semester begins. This course is not a substitute for the certificate of the German language level required for the application . The course fee is 75 euros for international students. Students will get 4 ECTS if they attend 80% of the course and pass the exam. During the semester, the Studienkolleg at KIT offers free German language courses for all students enrolled at KIT. Health insurance coverage is mandatory for your entire stay in Germany, with unlimited coverage. You can either obtain private health insurance in your home country before arriving in Karlsruhe or take out a German public health insurance before or after arrival. However, we strongly recommend choosing German public health insurance , as many private policies from non-EU countries may not be accepted. Without valid insurance, enrolment at the university is not possible. Students from partner universities pay a charge for the Studierendenwerk of about 92 € per semester. This includes reduced student prices at the university restaurant, transportation reductions, and accident insurance. Cost of Living

before.heading: 住宿資訊
before.text: KIT reserves rooms in student residences for students from partner universities. Accommodation is guaranteed if students adhere to the application procedure and deadlines. Details are sent by email after admission to KIT. The furnished single rooms cost between €250 and €350 per month and are rented for fixed lease periods: October to March (winter semester) and/or April to September (summer semester) . Please note that these rental periods are non-negotiable, and no alternative move-in or move-out dates are available. Please note that accommodation prices on the private market are significantly higher than those in student dorms, and there is also a risk of scams. For this reason, we highly recommend applying for a room in a student dorm through us. For students attending the pre-semester German language course (starting mid-September in the winter semester/mid-March in the summer semester), we recommend reserving accommodation in youth hostels, hostels, or Airbnb for the two weeks before the rental period of guaranteed rooms in the student residences. This must be arranged privately, as KIT unfortunately cannot assist with finding housing on the private market.

value.heading: 實用資訊
value.text: Language courses for exchange students VISA application information Exchange students must have comprehensive health insurance valid in Germany for enrolment as a fulltime student at FU Berlin AND for obtaining a residence permit. Exchange students are exempt from university fees, but they still need to pay the so-called semester ticket and social fees of approx. € 330 per semester.These fees are not paid to the university, but instead go to the student union and cover the cost of a public transportation ticket for the Berlin metropolitan area for the entire semester. Students will be asked to pay the fees before arrival in Berlin as part of the enrollment process. Freie Universität Berlin offers two scholarships for a period of ten months (1 October 2027 – 31 July 2028) with the following terms: - € 800 as a monthly grant; - € 500 health insurance allowance per semester; - Reimbursement of student fees (approx. € 300 per semester); - A waiver of registration fees.

value.heading: 注意事項
value.text: 交換學校一覽表所列之語言能力為該校之最低門檻要求，同學需自行確認語言能力是否符合該校修課要求、查詢是否有相對應的系所及足夠的課程可供選讀、能否達到該校之每學期修課學分數要求、以及是否具備相關領域之背景知識，若未達標準，該校有權拒收 。 該校絕大多數學士班課程為德語授課，僅具備英語能力者請務必確認是否有 足夠課程 可供選讀 Website of incoming exchange student information Course catalogue Please note that Human Medicine and Veterinary Medicine are NOT open to exchange students. With few exceptions, all undergraduate programs are open for exchange students. Enrollment in the following courses is subject to availability of lab classes and to prior approval by the institute/department: Biochemistry, Bioinformatics and Biology . Restrictions apply in Pharmacy, Law, Business Administration and Economics . The Law Department prefers direct exchange students from institutions who also accept law students. There are only very few places available for other exchange programs. The following master's degree programs are open for postgraduate exchange students without restriction: modern German literature, philosophy, and political science. All other master's degree programs are restricted and need prior approval from the institute/department.

Students will be asked to pay the fees before arrival in Berlin as part of the enrollment process. Freie Universität Berlin offers two scholarships for a period of ten months (1 October 2026 – 31 July 2027) with the following terms: - € 800 as a monthly grant; - € 500 health insurance allowance per semester; - Reimbursement of student fees (approx. € 300 per semester); - A waiver of registration fees.

value.heading: 實用資訊
value.text: Language courses for international and exchange students Cost of living: SEK 10,584-14,950 per month It is very important that all international students have complete insurance coverage for their entire stay in Sweden. Consequently, KTH asks all international students to have a complete insurance cover when arriving to KTH. Important areas that the insurance should cover are: personal injury, medical and dental care, accidents, personal belongings (luggage etc.), liability coverage, legal expense coverage, home transportation (in case of injury or illness). As a compliment the student is covered by the Student IN insurance provided by Kammarkollegiet.

before.heading: 實用資訊
before.text: Language courses for international and exchange students Cost of living: SEK 9,450-12,350 per month It is very important that all international students have complete insurance coverage for their entire stay in Sweden. Consequently, KTH asks all international students to have a complete insurance cover when arriving to KTH. Important areas that the insurance should cover are: personal injury, medical and dental care, accidents, personal belongings (luggage etc.), liability coverage, legal expense coverage, home transportation (in case of injury or illness). As a compliment the student is covered by the Student IN insurance provided by Kammarkollegiet.

value.heading: 注意事項
value.text: 交換學校一覽表所列之語言能力為該校之最低門檻要求，同學需自行確認語言能力是否符合該校修課要求、查詢是否有 相對應的系所及 足夠的課程可供選讀、能否達到該校之每學期修課學分數要求、以及是否具備相關領域之背景知識，若未達標準，該校有權拒收。 Website for incoming exchange student information. Useful information about courses for exchange students is listed here : 60 credits should be selected in order to have reserve options. Please note, the Swedish Migration Agency requires students to be accepted to full–time studies to issue residence permits for non-EU/EES students. Full-time study means 30 credits (or higher education points) per term . You cannot receive a residence permit for distance learning or online courses. Restricted subject areas for exchange students: Business Studies – Entry requirements vary considerably and are generally high. Admission to Master level courses requires a finished Bachelor's degree majoring in Business Studies. Limited spaces on certain courses. Biomedicine – A very strong academic background in the subject is required. Limited spaces. Economics – Courses are not available to exchange students. Government - Course availability is limited, particularly for courses with general entry requirements. History – Some courses have limited capacity. Immunology – A very strong academic background in the subject is required. Very limited spaces on courses. Law – Students must have completed at least two years of prior full-time Law studies. Places on specific courses cannot be guaranteed. Students who meet the academic requirements can normally be offered Law courses but should be flexible regarding course selection, as the courses offered may differ from those initially requested. Medicine – Clinical Medicine courses are not available through university-wide exchange agreements. Students applying for other Medicine courses must have a strong academic background in Medicine. No entry-level courses are taught in English. Musicology – Limited course availability (if any), with high entry requirements. Natural Sciences including Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Engineering – There are few to no entry-level courses taught in English. Students must have a very strong academic background in the relevant subject and meet the specific entry requirements. Very limited spaces on almost all courses. Pharmacy - A very strong academic background is required. Limited spaces. Philosophy – A limited selection of courses is available with high entry requirements. Psychology – Only a small number of basic-level courses are taught in English with extremely limited spaces available. Physiology and Anatomy – Courses are not available to students on university-wide exchange agreements. Sociology – None to very few courses available, with high entry requirements, depending on the semester. Courses offered within regular Bachelor's and Master's programmes, that are not included in the Course Catalogue for Exchange Students, are generally not available to exchange students. Please note: there is NO add-and-drop period at Uppsala University.

before.text: 一般組 本校大二以上/碩一以上/博一以上學生。（以報名交換學生甄選時，本校教務處學籍系統上之年級為準）。 TOEFL iBT 92 (接受 Home Edition) 或 IELTS 6.5 或 全民英檢中高級 或 培力英檢B2(中高級)。 不接受社會科學院經濟學系、社會科學院經濟學研究所( 其餘系所之修課限制，請詳閱注意事項說明 )之學生申請。

after.heading: 申請資格
after.text: 一般組 本校大二以上/碩一以上 (不含博士生) 學生。（以報名交換學生甄選時，本校教務處學籍系統上之年級為準）。 TOEFL iBT 4.5 (接受 Home Edition) 或 TOEFL iBT 92 (接受 Home Edition) 或 IELTS 6.5 或 全民英檢中高級 或 培力英檢B2(中高級)。 不接受社會科學院經濟學系、社會科學院經濟學研究所( 其餘系所之修課限制，請詳閱注意事項說明 )之學生申請。

before.heading: 注意事項
before.text: 交換學校一覽表所列之語言能力為該校之最低門檻要求，同學需自行確認語言能力是否符合該校修課要求、查詢是否有 相對應的系所及 足夠的課程可供選讀、能否達到該校之每學期修課學分數要求、以及是否具備相關領域之背景知識，若未達標準，該校有權拒收。 Website for incoming exchange student information. Useful information about courses for exchange students is listed here : 60 credits should be selected in order to have reserve options. Please note, the Swedish Migration Agency requires students to be accepted to full–time studies to issue residence permits for non-EU/EES students. Full-time study means 30 credits (or higher education points) per term . You cannot receive a residence permit for distance learning or online courses. Restricted subject areas for exchange students: Business Studies – entry requirements vary considerably and are generally high. Master level courses require a finished Bachelor's degree majoring in business. Biomedicine – Students must have a very strong academic background. Limited space. Economics – no courses available from the Department of Economics. Government – limited space on certain courses History – limited space on certain courses. Law – entry requirement is a minimum of two years of completed full time Law studies. Medicine – Clinical Medicine courses are not offered on university-wide exchange agreements. No entry-level courses taught in English. Students must have a strong academic background within Medicine and meet the entry requirements described in the course description. Natural Sciences including Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Engineering - few to no entry-level courses taught in English. Students must have a very strong academic background within these subjects and meet the entry requirements described in the course description. Pharmacy – Students must have a very strong academic background. Limited space. Philosophy – only few courses available with high entry requirements. Psychology – only few courses, on a basic level, taught in English with very limited space on courses. Sociology – only few courses available with high entry requirements. Please note: there is NO add-and-drop period at Uppsala University.

after.heading: 注意事項
after.text: 交換學校一覽表所列之語言能力為該校之最低門檻要求，同學需自行確認語言能力是否符合該校修課要求、查詢是否有 相對應的系所及 足夠的課程可供選讀、能否達到該校之每學期修課學分數要求、以及是否具備相關領域之背景知識，若未達標準，該校有權拒收。 Website for incoming exchange student information. Useful information about courses for exchange students is listed here : 60 credits should be selected in order to have reserve options. Please note, the Swedish Migration Agency requires students to be accepted to full–time studies to issue residence permits for non-EU/EES students. Full-time study means 30 credits (or higher education points) per term . You cannot receive a residence permit for distance learning or online courses. Restricted subject areas for exchange students: Business Studies – Entry requirements vary considerably and are generally high. Admission to Master level courses requires a finished Bachelor's degree majoring in Business Studies. Limited spaces on certain courses. Biomedicine – A very strong academic background in the subject is required. Limited spaces. Economics – Courses are not available to exchange students. Government - Course availability is limited, particularly for courses with general entry requirements. History – Some courses have limited capacity. Immunology – A very strong academic background in the subject is required. Very limited spaces on courses. Law – Students must have completed at least two years of prior full-time Law studies. Places on specific courses cannot be guaranteed. Students who meet the academic requirements can normally be offered Law courses but should be flexible regarding course selection, as the courses offered may differ from those initially requested. Medicine – Clinical Medicine courses are not available through university-wide exchange agreements. Students applying for other Medicine courses must have a strong academic background in Medicine. No entry-level courses are taught in English. Musicology – Limited course availability (if any), with high entry requirements. Natural Sciences including Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Engineering – There are few to no entry-level courses taught in English. Students must have a very strong academic background in the relevant subject and meet the specific entry requirements. Very limited spaces on almost all courses. Pharmacy - A very strong academic background is required. Limited spaces. Philosophy – A limited selection of courses is available with high entry requirements. Psychology – Only a small number of basic-level courses are taught in English with extremely limited spaces available. Physiology and Anatomy – Courses are not available to students on university-wide exchange agreements. Sociology – None to very few courses available, with high entry requirements, depending on the semester. Courses offered within regular Bachelor's and Master's programmes, that are not included in the Course Catalogue for Exchange Students, are generally not available to exchange students. Please note: there is NO add-and-drop period at Uppsala University.

value.text: 交換學校一覽表所列之語言能力為該校之最低門檻要求，同學需自行確認語言能力是否符合該校修課要求、查詢是否有相對應的系所及足夠的課程可供選讀、能否達到該校之每學期修課學分數要求、以及是否具備相關領域之背景知識，若未達標準，該校有權拒收。 Website of incoming exchange student program Course information Available subject areas: Management, Business Administration, Economics, Political Sciences and Law CEMS MiM courses, Business Journalism and Business teacher education courses are NOT open to exchange students Guest students are required to take at least 16 ECTS credits and may not exceed 40 ECTS credits per semester.

completion_observations.text_zh: Monash2027接收規則：學士在交換開始前完成一年，平均60%或GPA3.0/4.0或ECTS C／母校等值；碩士通常完成一年，同校同領域接續學位有例外。仍須符合英文與課程先修，不能取代臺大甄選條件。
completion_observations.scope: Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認

completion_observations.text_zh: 2027Monash需歷次／現校正式成績單及必要英文認證翻譯、英文能力證明（適用者）、護照個資頁、所選課先修證明／英文課綱；資料齊全後才評估申請。交換生必須等母校提名釋出專用表，誤用direct apply會轉為自費Study Abroad。
completion_observations.scope: Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認
completion_observations.evidence_locator: Preparing your application; page4 Completing your application

completion_observations.text_zh: Monash2027 Exchange接收申請：Semester1截止2026/11/1，Semester2截止2027/4/1，澳洲／馬來西亞同日；Study Abroad截止不同。這是接待校流程，不是臺大116-1報名期限，無法由此推定臺大名額。
completion_observations.scope: Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認

completion_observations.text_zh: Monash2027必到交換orientation：Australia Semester1抵達2/15、Semester2抵達7/19；Malaysia為2/17與7/14。交換orientation在全校orientation前一週、上課前兩週，無法按澳洲日期替代馬來西亞。
completion_observations.scope: Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認

completion_observations.text_zh: Monash2027澳洲住房可在未獲offer前申請校內、免申請費並標Monash Abroad；按先到先得配房。校外由校方提供搜尋與租屋支援，非保證。Malaysia住房與澳洲條件不得混用。
completion_observations.scope: Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認

completion_observations.text_zh: Monash2027文件区分：Exchange須母校雙邊提名，學費續向母校付；Study Abroad向Monash付。生活費链接主要為完整學位國際生，交換可能不同，未取一般學位價格作個人交換報價。
completion_observations.scope: Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認
completion_observations.evidence_locator: Study abroad or exchange?; page6 living costs limitations

completion_observations.text_zh: 2027Monash校区與課程限制：Clayton工程／理／學士法、Caulfield藝設建築、Parkville藥學；Malaysia需整學期在該校區。其他Alfred/Gippsland/Prato/Singapore/Suzhou地點不可選；查Handbook是否開放exchange，通常每學期四課中最多一課線上，須6–8課備選。
completion_observations.scope: Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認
completion_observations.evidence_locator: Campuses in Australia; page3 Study plan restrictions

completion_observations.text_zh: Monash2027澳洲校區錄取接受與適用OSHC繳付證明後才出CoE，標準為subclass500 Non-Award；OSHC只基本醫療，不含國際旅行／行李等。Malaysia另需醫療保險付款後進行簽證；簽證由身分與當期政府規則決定。
completion_observations.scope: Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認
completion_observations.evidence_locator: Next steps Australia/Malaysia; page6 visas and OSHC

completion_observations.text_zh: Victoria Wellington已提供2027宿舍指南，含供餐一年級型與獨立生活房型；個別交換生可否申請、校區及一trimester合約需另核，不把一般新生房型視為交換分房。
completion_observations.scope: Victoria University of Wellington accommodation guide2027，PDF實體頁碼與印刷頁碼不同

completion_observations.text_zh: 2027住宿指南第10實體頁仍註明費用基於2026全年39週合約；一trimester19週合約可能加10%，2027費率可變，不能重標表中價格為2027確定費用。
completion_observations.scope: Guide2027所列費用明示為2026合約基準；新年費用待核

completion_observations.text_zh: 2027冊子Exchange申請需母校提名、英文成績單、適用英語證明及認證護照資料頁；提名後收到邀請，交換Certificate of Proficiency與付費Study Abroad管道須區分。
completion_observations.scope: Auckland2027 flyer / Exchange流程，母校資格與名額另核

completion_observations.text_zh: 2027冊子說按期限申請的study abroad／exchange生有校內住宿承諾，但家庭／伴侶房除外；同頁2027開關日期與「2027費用、期限、合約尚未定案」註腳並存，不能據此設確定提醒。
completion_observations.scope: Auckland Study Abroad/Exchange flyer2027，第10頁同時列2026價格合約與2027尚未定案註腳，需正式住宿網站核對

completion_observations.text_zh: 2027冊子住宿表實際仍是2026年21週合約：Te Tirohanga NZ$7,677.50、Carlaw Park NZ$8,097.50、Stuart McCutcheon NZ$8,307.50；不能改稱2027費用。
completion_observations.scope: Auckland Study Abroad/Exchange flyer2027，第10頁同時列2026價格合約與2027尚未定案註腳，需正式住宿網站核對

completion_observations.text_zh: 2027冊子Exchange列Exchange Student Visa，付費Study Abroad列Fee Paying Student Visa與學費收據；不能把V方案付款義務移作E交換規則。
completion_observations.scope: Auckland2027 flyer / Exchange與Study Abroad並列，學生簽證個案以官方核定
completion_observations.evidence_locator: Exchange step6 vs Study Abroad step6

completion_observations.text_zh: UCT國際辦可按住房webform協助校內外選項，建議旅行前安排。一般宿舍須隨學術申請提出且不晚於入學前一年7/31；Semester Study Abroad第二學期另給流程，不能當臺大交換已配房或2027固定期限。
completion_observations.scope: 接待校公開一般參考；未明列2027–28，個人交換資格、實際房源或費用仍需核定
completion_observations.evidence_locator: Accommodation and Housing; on-campus accommodation; semester-study-abroad exception

completion_observations.text_zh: Stellenbosch國際生可申請大學宿舍、SU International管理房／公寓或私人房；錄取學術方案不保證住宿，須另行申請。
completion_observations.scope: 接待校公開生活參考；未明列2027–28，校區、交換身分與分房仍需核定
